scheme_name: Pre Matric Scholarship For Students With Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student studying in Class 9th or Class 10th in a government school or a school recognized by the government, CBSE or State Board.
Disability percentage must be 40 % or above as defined in the Schedule of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
Applicant must not be receiving any other government scholarship.
Applicant must not be the third sibling in the family who has already received this scholarship.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly maintenance allowance of ₹500 for day scholars or ₹800 for hostellers, an annual book grant of ₹1,000, and disability‑specific annual allowances ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹4,000.
